summary: The shared setup policy and authorization-only Web route now carry one immutable trusted advisory-context snapshot, canonical v2 digest and deployment-owned management-authority identity while preserving ordinary startup and the existing concrete certificate verifier.

behavioral_red.observation: Missing trusted-context validation, semantic digest and immutable forwarding produced the expected policy failures.
The old grant lacked selectedContext and accepted legacy v1, missing management identity, same-grant value change and colliding cross-authority validation.

policy: Both final launcher runs passed the 286-source suite inventory and policy checks.
test_owner_assessment: The tests exercise public Core and actual Program-host seams with independent v2/context assertions, controlled SQLite/certificate/clock inputs and test-owned Data Protection keys. The retained A-to-B acceptance RED makes the cross-authority GREEN meaningful. No test refactor was needed.
production_owner_assessment: Program owns frozen explicit-mode configuration; the activation service owns consistent live context capture, v2 protection and revalidation. Responsibilities remain localized and no post-GREEN refactor was justified.
remaining_scope: Persistence, prepared-source approval, source adapter, selector, generator composition, provider binding, isolation diagnostics and owned-resource qualification remain assigned to later tasks. T020 and T029 remain held pending explicit owned resources.
